Title: Upcoming billing changes to Azure Bastion

Body.Content:
Beginning earlier this year, we have been continuously rolling out Azure Bastion across the Azure Government regions. The roll-out is finalized, and the billing of Azure Bastion in US Gov Zone 1 will start on October 1st, 2020. 

Effective 10/1/2020 the meter IDs of Azure Bastion will also change in Azure US Gov Zone 1, as per the table. You will need to modify billing routines that rely on resource GUIDs.
